fields.name: applicationName
fields.description: Target application the issue belongs to (e.g. 'MailCraft').

fields.name: url
fields.description: Page or endpoint where the issue was detected.

fields.name: category
fields.description: authentication | authorization | navigation | ui | functional | forms | api | performance | accessibility | other.

fields.name: status
fields.description: open | investigating | confirmed | fixed | resolved | wont_fix | ignored | reopened.

fields.name: reproductionStepsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded string[] of ordered reproduction steps.

fields.name: evidenceJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded Evidence[] (type/label/value/timestamp/storageRef). Stringified so the row fits the Blocks Data primitive-only field types.

fields.name: detectedAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp of detection. Used as the default sort key.

fields.name: verificationRunId
fields.description: ID of the verification run that first surfaced the issue. Optional so legacy/test rows can exist without a run linkage.

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.description: Stable dedup key: hash of origin+pathname | category | normalized title (digits collapsed to '#'). Same defect re-detected across runs matches here instead of creating a duplicate row. Empty on legacy rows created before fingerprinting.

fields.name: occurrenceCount
fields.description: How many runs have re-detected this defect (numeric string — Blocks Data stores primitives only). '1' on first detection.

fields.name: lastSeenAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp of the most recent detection. Distinct from detectedAt, which stays frozen at first detection.

fields.name: seenInRunIdsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded string[] of verification run ids that detected this defect, newest last, capped to keep the row small.

fields.name: assignedDeveloperIdsJson
fields.description: JSON-encoded string[] of OIDC subs of the developers this issue is assigned to (multi-select from the issue-group dropdown). Empty while unassigned.

fields.name: approvedById
fields.description: OIDC sub of the tester who manually re-tested and approved this issue after the AI verification run. Empty while unapproved — only approved issues are assignable to developers.
